results.q: Add a concept note on A* search: a best-first search for shortest paths that adds a heuristic estimate of the remaining distance to the distance so far; it generalises Dijkstra's algorithm and keeps its frontier in a priority queue over a graph. Follow the framework rules for adding a concept.

Add a concept note on red-black trees: a self-balancing binary search tree that colours nodes red or black so that every path has the same number of black nodes, keeping operations logarithmic; used for ordered maps where a hash table gives no order. Follow the framework rules for adding a concept.

Add a concept note on momentum: mass times velocity, conserved in an isolated system; Newton's second law says force is its rate of change, its derivative with respect to time. Follow the framework rules for adding a concept.

Add a concept note on the determinant: a number computed from a square matrix that is zero exactly when the matrix is not invertible; the eigenvalues are the roots of the determinant of the matrix minus λ times the identity. Follow the framework rules for adding a concept.
